arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys, re, json, zipfile, shutil, os

IN_DOCX = "inputs/offer_letter_template.docx"
IN_JSON = "inputs/employee_data.json"
OUT_DOCX = "output/offer_letter_filled.docx"

def fail(msg):
    sys.stderr.write("ERROR: " + msg + "\n")
    sys.exit(1)

with open(IN_JSON, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Namespaces / regex helpers ------------------------------------------------
# Match a <w:p>...</w:p> paragraph (no nested <w:p>; Word paragraphs don't nest).
P_RE = re.compile(r"<w:p\b[^>]*>.*?</w:p>|<w:p\b[^>]*/>", re.DOTALL)
# Match the text inside a <w:t ...>...</w:t> element, capturing prefix/body/suffix
T_RE = re.compile(r"(<w:t\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</w:t>)", re.DOTALL)

# Simple fields that are straightforward token replacements.
SIMPLE_FIELDS = [
    "RECORD_CODE", "CUSTODIAN_NAME", "EQUIPMENT_DESCRIPTION",
    "ORGANIZATION_NAME", "ISSUE_DATE", "DETAIL_NOTE",
    "OWNER_NAME", "ADDRESS_LINE", "RELOCATION_AMOUNT",
]

XML_ESCAPES = [("&", "&"), ("<", "<"), (">", ">"),
               ('"', """), ("'", "'")]

def xml_escape(s):
    for a, b in XML_ESCAPES:
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    return s

def get_required(name):
    if name not in data:
        fail("missing required field '%s' in employee_data.json" % name)
    v = data[name]
    if v is None:
        fail("required field '%s' is null" % name)
    return str(v)

def process_paragraph(p_xml, counters):
    """Fill tokens inside a single paragraph.

    Collects the concatenated text across runs, performs token substitution
    (including the IF_RELOCATION conditional), then writes the resulting text
    back into the paragraph's <w:t> runs (first run gets the full text, others
    emptied)."""
    t_matches = list(T_RE.finditer(p_xml))
    if not t_matches:
        return p_xml

    combined = "".join(m.group(2) for m in t_matches)
    # Unescape for logical processing
    def unescape(s):
        s = s.replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
        s = s.replace(""", '"').replace("'", "'")
        s = s.replace("&", "&")
        return s
    combined_u = unescape(combined)

    original = combined_u

    # --- Conditional handling (within this paragraph only) ---
    if "{{IF_RELOCATION}}" in combined_u or "{{END_IF_RELOCATION}}" in combined_u:
        if "{{IF_RELOCATION}}" not in combined_u or "{{END_IF_RELOCATION}}" not in combined_u:
            fail("conditional IF_RELOCATION/END_IF_RELOCATION not balanced within a paragraph")
        # Governing field required.
        gov = get_required("RELOCATION_PACKAGE")
        keep = (gov == "Yes")
        pattern = re.compile(r"\{\{IF_RELOCATION\}\}(.*?)\{\{END_IF_RELOCATION\}\}", re.DOTALL)
        def repl_cond(m):
            counters["IF_RELOCATION"] = counters.get("IF_RELOCATION", 0) + 1
            return m.group(1) if keep else ""
        combined_u = pattern.sub(repl_cond, combined_u)

    # --- Simple field substitution ---
    for name in SIMPLE_FIELDS:
        tok = "{{" + name + "}}"
        if tok in combined_u:
            val = get_required(name)
            combined_u = combined_u.replace(tok, val)
            counters[name] = counters.get(name, 0) + 1

    # Detect any leftover declared-looking tokens (safety). Allowed leftovers: none.
    leftover = re.findall(r"\{\{[A-Z0-9_]+\}\}", combined_u)
    if leftover:
        fail("unresolved token(s) after fill: %s" % sorted(set(leftover)))

    if combined_u == original:
        return p_xml  # nothing changed

    # Write back: first <w:t> gets full text, remaining emptied.
    new_text_esc = xml_escape(combined_u)
    parts = []
    last = 0
    for i, m in enumerate(t_matches):
        parts.append(p_xml[last:m.start()])
        if i == 0:
            open_tag = m.group(1)
            # ensure xml:space preserve so leading/trailing spaces survive
            if "xml:space" not in open_tag:
                open_tag = open_tag[:-1] + ' xml:space="preserve">'
            parts.append(open_tag + new_text_esc + m.group(3))
        else:
            parts.append(m.group(1) + m.group(3))
        last = m.end()
    parts.append(p_xml[last:])
    return "".join(parts)

def process_xml(xml, counters):
    def repl_p(m):
        return process_paragraph(m.group(0), counters)
    return P_RE.sub(repl_p, xml)

# --- Main: read zip, process relevant parts, write new zip ---
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(IN_DOCX, "r")
names = zin.namelist()

# Parts to process: document body + all header/footer parts.
process_parts = set()
for n in names:
    if n == "word/document.xml":
        process_parts.add(n)
    elif re.match(r"word/(header|footer)\d+\.xml$", n):
        process_parts.add(n)

counters = {}
new_contents = {}
for n in names:
    raw = zin.read(n)
    if n in process_parts:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
        text = process_xml(text, counters)
        raw = text.encode("utf-8")
    new_contents[n] = raw
zin.close()

# Ensure the governing field was exercised at least where conditional appeared.
# (process_paragraph already fails if RELOCATION_PACKAGE missing when needed.)

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT_DOCX), exist_ok=True)
infos = {}
with zipfile.ZipFile(IN_DOCX, "r") as zin2:
    for zi in zin2.infolist():
        infos[zi.filename] = zi

with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT_DOCX, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n in names:
        zi = infos[n]
        newzi = zipfile.ZipInfo(n, date_time=zi.date_time)
        newzi.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        newzi.external_attr = zi.external_attr
        newzi.internal_attr = zi.internal_attr
        newzi.create_system = zi.create_system
        zout.writestr(newzi, new_contents[n])

print("Filled fields (occurrences):")
for k in sorted(counters):
    print("  %-24s %d" % (k, counters[k]))
print("Wrote", OUT_DOCX)
